mentorSummary_event11:
I made all seven changes to `Employee_List` and `Employee_Detail`. The last run reported no validation errors. I haven't opened the screens in a browser, so please check the layout there. I didn't publish the app.

### `Employee_List`
- **Department join:** `GetEmployees` now has `Department` as a source, joined to `Employee` on `DepartmentId` with "With or Without". Employees with no department stay in the result.
- **Table column:** `EmployeesTable` has a new last column with the header "Department", showing the department `Label`. It is empty when the employee has no department.
- **Dropdown and variable:** I added `Dropdown_Department`, labelled "Department", below `Input_Search` in the same container. I also added the local variable `SelectedDepartmentId`, typed Department Identifier with an empty default, and bound the dropdown to it.
- **Dropdown options:** They come from a new aggregate, `GetDepartments`, sorted by `Id` ascending (Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, Sales). The empty option is "All departments" and is the default.
- **Department filter:** `GetEmployees` has a new filter: no restriction when `SelectedDepartmentId` is empty, otherwise `Employee.DepartmentId` must equal it. It combines with the existing `IsActive` and `SearchKeyword` filters, which I left as they were.
- **Dropdown change:** It calls the existing `Search` screen action, so `GetEmployees` refreshes and the search text is kept.

### `Employee_Detail`
- **Department join:** `GetEmployeeById` has `Department` as a source joined to `Employee` on `DepartmentId` with "With or Without".
- **New field:** `DetailCard` has a new last field, "Department", showing the department `Label`. It is read-only like the other fields and is empty when the employee has no department.

### Skipped and manual steps
I skipped nothing and added no library dependencies, so there are no manual steps. I changed nothing outside your list.

The dropdown sits on its own line under the search input rather than beside it. Tell me if you want it side by side.
